phases.source_text:
A realistic action film about a woman, Amy, protecting her two kids from a zombie apocalypse.
Amy is at home on a normal day, cooking breakfast for her young kids (Will and Amber).
A zombie breaks into the house. Amy rushes her two kids to a safe location and returns to the kitchen.
She retrieves her hidden arsenal consisting of a pistol and a katana.
The majority of the film is Amy killing (dismembering, decapitating, shooting, etc.) zombies as they try and attack her.
After Amy kills the last of the zombies, she retrieves her kids from their safe location.

generated_beats_text:
# Phase 1
1. Amy flips pancakes in the kitchen while Will and Amber sit at the table, turns them golden brown, and places each on a plate.
2. A zombie bursts through the front door; Amy carries Will and Amber to a locked basement before heading back to the kitchen.
3. In the pantry behind the fridge, Amy pulls out her concealed pistol and gleaming katana.
4. A zombie strides into the living room, and Amy fires a pistol shot to its skull.
5. Another zombie bursts through the kitchen door, and Amy slices its neck cleanly with the katana.
6. An aggressive zombie lunges from the hall; Amy shoots its torso before slicing its head with the katana.
7. A fourth zombie shambles into the bedroom, and Amy cleaves its skull off with one swift katana strike.
8. After killing the last zombie, Amy unlocks the basement hatch and pulls Will and Amber into her arms.
